name: Samantha Schmütz
bio: Samantha Schmütz Cannet (born January 28, 1979) is a Brazilian actress, comedian, singer and voice actress.

credits.title: Summer High
credits.overview: In 1987, two police officers with polar-opposite personalities must team up for the biggest case of their lives when thousands of cans filled with marijuana wash up on Brazilian beaches, threatening to plunge the country into total chaos.

To salvage his situation, he decides to produce an alien movie using the ugliest people in the local population.

credits.overview: Beatriz is a famous psychoanalyst who teaches others to be happy, but isn't able to be happy herself. Things take a turn when her mother's death takes her traveling with her sister to Buenos Aires to comply with the unusual directives she left in her will.

credits.overview: Selminha is a lower-class woman who receives a family inheritance, but only if she meets the challenge of spending 30 million reais in 30 days, without accumulating anything. However, in this marathon, she will find out that there are things that money does not buy.

credits.title: Paulo Gustavo - Hyperactive
credits.overview: The theatrical phenomenon arrives in digital format: Paulo Gustavo presents Hiperativo, a stand-up solo show that conquered Brazil. With his peculiar and sharp humor, the actor explores fears, relationships, and everyday paranoias in an epic recording full of illustrious guests and contagious energy.
